text.trigger: A player searches at the School while John Price is in the survivor deck and the colony has room.
text.vignette: From the long school corridor come thumps and a muffled shout; a boy is hammering on the cafeteria door while the dead shuffle up behind him. You hold the key and have about three seconds.

options.open-the-door: Let him out: John Price leaves the survivor deck and joins your following, but he leaves you to the 2 zombies that are added at the School.
options.raid-the-cafeteria: Hesitate and take what the distraction gives you: 2 food is added to the supply and John Price is removed from the game.
